text:
A housing bear can hide behind a rising dollar price.

Since June 2022, national Case-Shiller prices are up 9.3% in dollars but down 3.3% after inflation, through August.

The median new home cost about 92 oz of gold in Q3. That is close to the 1980 lows near 100 oz, even with mortgage rates above 7%.

My read: housing can turn up in gold before rates peak. That does not require dollar home prices to rise. The 1980s are a comparison, not a forecast.

This week's letter: The Housing Bear in Gold
